html: † סֻכּוֹת בְּנוֹת n.pr.div. 2 K 17:30, Assyrian-Bab. deity, worshipped by Babylonians in Samaria; text of name corrupt; SchrCOT ad loc. (after H. Rawlinson) proposes Zîr-bânit, or Zarpanituv, wife of Marduk (cf. HptAndover Rev., May 1886 Muss-ArnoltJBL xi (1892), 167), rejecting Sakkut-binûtu = Marduk DlPar 215; JenZA iv. 352 makes בְּנוֹת = banîtu, epithet of Ištar; all doubtful.
